sources.snippet: The first three files provide complete DRAMA synthesis. ASR, alignment and VAD are optional per workflow. Keep the R2T2 Q8 main model and matching projector together. Download complete folders for the aligner and VAD. All paths can be overridden in the nodes or studio settings; the studio uses the same layout directly under its models/ directory.
